fullPassage:
Best Soccer Leagues in the World

English Premier League - England
The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, established in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of importance. Among the 20 teams, Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, and Tottenham are considered the "Big 6." This league's players compete at the highest level, play at a fast pace, and have the highest level of skill of all the soccer leagues.

La Liga - Spain
Spain's professional league, La Liga, was established in 1929 and has a total of 20 teams. Like the EPL, La Liga's teams play each other twice, for a total of 38 games each season. This league is famous for its highly technical and creative players. The world's two most famous players both played in La Liga until 2021, starring for Barcelona and Real Madrid respectively. Barcelona and Real Madrid are such strong rivals that their games are known worldwide as "el clasico," meaning "the classic."

Bundesliga - Germany
Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. Like La Liga and EPL, each team plays all the other teams twice. The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing. This means that when a team loses control of the ball, they swiftly attack rather than retreat. While FC Bayern München is considered the strongest team, all 18 teams are known for their physical play styles and well organized strategies.

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, ①<u>establishing</u> in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of importance. Among the 20 teams, Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, and Tottenham are ②<u>considered</u> the "Big 6." This league's players ③<u>compete</u> at the highest level, play at a fast pace, and ④<u>have</u> the highest level of skill of all the soccer leagues.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① establishing → established. EPL이 설립'된' 것이므로 수동(과거분사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① establishing: EPL은 설립되는 대상이므로 수동 established 필요
✅ ② considered: are considered (수동태)
✅ ③ compete: players(복수) + 복수동사
✅ ④ have: players(복수) + 복수동사, compete/play/have 병렬
det.tip: established(수동) vs establishing(능동). 리그가 '설립된' 것이므로 과거분사

questions.passage: Spain's professional league, La Liga, was established in 1929 and has a total of 20 teams. Like the EPL, La Liga's teams play ①<u>each other</u> twice, for a total of 38 games each season. This league is famous for ②<u>its</u> highly technical and creative players. The world's two most famous players both played in La Liga until 2021, starring for Barcelona and Real Madrid ③<u>respective</u>. Barcelona and Real Madrid are ④<u>such</u> strong rivals that their games are known worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ respective → respectively. 부사가 필요한 자리 (각각)
det.analysis:
✅ ① each other: 서로를 — 대명사 올바름
✅ ② its: La Liga's → its (소유격)
❌ ③ respective: 문장 끝에서 '각각'을 뜻하는 부사 respectively가 필요
✅ ④ such: such + 형용사 + 명사 + that 구문 올바름
det.tip: respective(형용사, 각각의) vs respectively(부사, 각각). 여기서는 문장 끝 부사 자리

questions.passage: Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. Like La Liga and EPL, each team plays all the other teams twice. The league is famous for a technique ①<u>called</u> gegenpressing. This means that when a team ②<u>loses</u> control of the ball, they swiftly attack rather than ③<u>retreating</u>. While FC Bayern München is ④<u>considered</u> the strongest team, all 18 teams are known for their physical play styles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ retreating → retreat. rather than 뒤에는 동사원형
det.analysis:
✅ ① called: 수동 (불리는 기술)
✅ ② loses: 3인칭 단수(a team) + 단수동사
❌ ③ retreating: rather than 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 함. attack rather than retreat
✅ ④ considered: is considered (수동태)
det.tip: rather than + 동사원형: 'attack rather than retreat' (공격하기보다 후퇴하다). -ing가 오면 틀림

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, ①<u>established</u> in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of importance. This league's players ②<u>compete</u> at the highest level, play at a fast ③<u>pace</u>, and have the highest level of skill of all the soccer leagues. La Liga is famous for its highly technical and ④<u>monotonous</u> players.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ monotonous(단조로운) → creative(창의적인). La Liga는 기술적이고 '창의적인' 선수로 유명
det.analysis:
✅ ① established: 원문 그대로
✅ ② compete: 원문 그대로
✅ ③ pace: 원문 그대로
❌ ④ monotonous: 원문은 creative. '단조로운'은 '창의적'의 반대
det.tip: creative(창의적인) ↔ monotonous(단조로운)

questions.passage: Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and ①<u>nearby</u> countries. The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing. This means that when a team loses control of the ball, they ②<u>hesitantly</u> attack rather than retreat. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② hesitantly(주저하며) → swiftly(빠르게). gegenpressing은 빠르게 공격하는 것
det.analysis:
✅ ① nearby: 원문 그대로
❌ ② hesitantly: 원문은 swiftly. '주저하며'는 '빠르게'의 반대
✅ ③ strongest: 원문 그대로
✅ ④ physical: 원문 그대로
det.tip: swiftly(빠르게) ↔ hesitantly(주저하며). gegenpressing의 핵심은 빠른 반응
